sourceInterfaceMapping: Directory groups record source-interface family ownership, not exact historical per-function provenance. Function-specific server provenance remains in component_contracts.json; shared bindings below identify exact shared interfaces.
testReferenceMapping: Static direct calls, explicit imports/references and patch targets from tests/cases only. Original identities link COMPONENTS.json; new epoch-prover dependency cases link their own source. No indirect or measured execution coverage is claimed.

verificationMethod.coverageMeasurement: Individual function execution and branch coverage were not measured. Imports, patch targets and source calls do not establish that the original implementation or every branch executed. No indirect coverage is inferred.
verificationMethod.deduplication: Active-server function references remain canonical in component_contracts.json. Module references describe explicit module/class sources; function references describe their resolved implementations.
